methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
presents the challenges and benefits of an ISO 50001 imple-
mentation in an industrial environment as well as the meth-
odology and systematic approach, but also tools such as 
energy controlling systems and measurement equipment 
which are helpful to achieve energetic transparency.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: ISO 50001 implementation framework and tools are described, but no EnPI or EnB measurement model is identified or characterised.

paper_type.evidence_quote:
the approach to energy management systems 
according to the ISO 50001 standard has been presented. It 
is an instrument, and a set of systematic methods, to gain 
control over an organization’s energy consumption and 
achieve a sustainable and significant reduction.

stage1.notes: The paper mentions establishing a baseline and EnPIs only as ISO 50001 implementation steps; it provides no variables, functional form, or estimation approach.
